title: Ramona M FDE 9135 NDE 9135
content: I was trying to get home, running late for curfew, and driving home on county roads late at night. It had been raining, so the roads were slippery and it was extremely foggy. A car was tailgating me and it made me nervous. So, I sped up and kept speeding up. I still felt like the car was following too closely. On an S- turn, I felt the back end of the car coming up around. I had just had a driver's training course that taught me exactly how to correct this. Yet, before I could act, I heard a powerful voice and felt like I didn't have a choice in what to do. At the same time, I also had a most peaceful sense of surrender come over me. The voice told me, 'Take your hands off the wheel.' Time slowed down as the back end of the car came around. It felt like I was up above and watching the car. In slow motion, the back end of the car came around and shot across the road. The back end crashed into a hydro-pole. The next moment, I awoke to find that the car was entirely crunched up around the pole. The pole had torn through the entire car and was now beside me. The entire car was totaled with the exception of my little square driver's seat. I was completely unscratched. The rest is hazy, how I got out, how the ambulance and fire truck came. I remember smelling gas everywhere. A woman approached me but there was never a sign of the car behind me or if it even existed. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 2003 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Accident. Illness, trauma or other condition not considered life threatening How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal I had a clear knowing, clarity, no question, strength, power, and connection. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I don't know that I've ever been so alert, clear, or sure of hearing from a direct instruction as the moment I felt the back end of the car slipping out behind me. Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. Time slowed down, stopped, to the point I left time and space Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. It was foggy and the bright light behind me made it almost impossible to see. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Everything went silent, but the instructions to take my hands off the wheel. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? An unusually bright light Did you see an unearthly light? Uncertain. Was the light behind me me a car? Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? Peace. Then fear when came back to my body. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt no longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe. Just a sense of trust and surrender Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Other Christian What is your religion now? Other or several faiths Open, see many similarities, still believe in Christian faith to some degree, pagan, new age etc. I fell we learn from many Faiths Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. I was questioning faith at the time. I felt it was an angelic presence Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes New trust Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin. Clear strong deliberate trustworthy, felt more feminine or non-gender specific Did you see deceased or religious spirits? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes. It wasn't me that acted and a voice came from somewhere otherworldly During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes I felt an overwhelming sense something or someone else took over. Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes I felt touched by heaven, angels, or something else. During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife probably exists. Uncertain. I felt something else took over and a connection to something bigger than my earthly world Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? Uncertain. We try to control to much. The answer is to surrender. During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Slight changes in my life Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes Fear people wouldn't get it or believe.me. How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Uncertain. I think I've always had access to psychic abilities Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? The voice. Also, I question the light and the existence of the other car Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Days after. Still now. People don't really give reaction. Feels like people don't know what to say Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. I wanted to die before that. My grandmother pointed out God had a bigger plan for me. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real It happened. It was real. I've got a mission. Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? Yes

arrival.other_being_detail: Heard a "powerful voice" giving a direct instruction; described as "clear strong deliberate trustworthy, felt more feminine or non-gender specific."

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Time slowing/stopping; instruction: "Take your hands off the wheel."
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE-like vantage and communication occurred during the accident sequence without tunnel/otherworld entry; immediate awakening back in the car.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Voice instruction and sense of being above/watching the car occurred as the car spun/crashed in slow motion.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Possible ambiguity about the "unusually bright light" behind her (questioned whether it was a car) and uncertainty whether the tailgating car existed; instruction to remove hands from the wheel during the crash.
